description: Golden vectors for the passkey challenge domains, format v1. A passkey signs whatever WebAuthn challenge it is handed, and the LazorKit programs approve a transaction by the challenge in a passkey signature, so each kind of challenge has its own shape and no challenge of one kind can equal one of another: a transaction challenge is a 32-byte SHA-256 hash; a message challenge is tag || SHA-256(tag || message), 58 bytes, tag = UTF-8 "LazorKit signed message v1"; an ownership-proof challenge is tag || 32 random bytes, 59 bytes, tag = UTF-8 "LazorKit ownership proof v1". The first three message vectors are the fixed vectors of @lazorkit/wallet 3.3.1 (lazor-kit packages/react/test/sign-message.test.mjs, from lazor-kit #113, 704ba51) and the fourth is that test's UTF-8 case; all four were recomputed with node:crypto and with the wallet's own signedMessageChallenge (lazor-kit 22e0ec2). Both SDKs must give the same bytes as the wallet packages.

vectors.name: a string, signed as its UTF-8 bytes
32 zero bytes: the length of a transaction challenge, never signed as one
